body.x: 4S Mapper (CEO Seung-Ho Lee) announced that the company will be participating as an exhibitor in “Drone Show Korea 2023,” which will be held from Thursday, February 23 to Saturday, February 25 at BEXCO, Busan.

As a GeoAI specialist, 4S Mapper processes data based on spatial information and analyzes data based on AI. In particular, the company specializes in automatic and distributed processing of large volume data.

The company will be showcasing products by FIXAR and SHARE at this year’s exhibition. FIXAR’s VTOL drone can be equipped with various RTK sensors and handle long flights. VTOL recently completed a test flight at an altitude of 6,000 meters. Optimized for a variety of functions including autonomous flight, the product completed demonstration and test flights during the “Commercial UAB” exhibition held in Las Vegas, U.S., in September 2022.

According to a 4S Mapper representative, “DJI drones are used in many different industry sectors domestically. However, it is difficult to find 3rd party products that are developed to be completely compatible with Payload SDK in Korea. We signed a partnership with SHARE in InterGeo 2022 held last October in Germany, and its line of products are fully compatible with DJI drones.”

4S Mapper conducted a joint project for road traffic algorithms in collaboration with the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Lausanne (EPFL) and the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST) in 2022. Furthermore, the company participated in CES 2023 held in Las Vegas, U.S. in January. The firm plans to participate as an exhibitor in Geo Connect (Drones Asia 2023), which will be held in Singapore in March, with the goal of continuing to pursue new overseas businesses.

“We will be expanding our portfolio from the current drone-related products and solutions to tailored solutions for satellite/aviation data, including large volume, distributed processing, as well as data acquisition using various sensors,” the representative added.

The following items will be showcased in Drone Show Korea 2023 sponsored by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, the Ministry of Science and ICT, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the Ministry of National Defense, and the Busan Metropolitan City Government, and organized by BEXCO and the Korea Unmanned Aerial Vehicle System Association: △Manufacture (drone, military, UAM/AAM, surveying, mapping, firefighting, station, unmanned robot, leisure, broadcasting), △Applicable industries (filming, control, spatial information, logistics, disaster management, security, reconnaissance, construction, deep sea exploration, etc.), △Parts and technologies (communication, ground control, autonomous flight, system and S/W technology, fuel cell sensors, motors, batteries, etc.), △Service (education, finance, rental, insurance, investment consulting, etc.), △Institutions (related institutions, associations/organizations, universities).
